name: PM Vishwakarma
summary: Training with a ₹500 daily stipend and collateral-free credit for traditional artisans.
description: Recognition, skill training, toolkit support and collateral-free credit for artisans and craftspeople in specified family-based traditional trades.
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
implementingAuthority: Ministry of MSME, MSDE and Department of Financial Services
targetBeneficiaries: Artisans and craftspeople in the 18 specified traditional trades

criteria.label: Artisan or craftsperson in a family-based traditional trade

evidence.quote: An artisan or craftsperson working with hands and tools and engaged in one of the family-based traditional trades specified in Para 2.3, in the unorganized or informal sector, on self-employment basis, shall be eligible for registration under PM Vishwakarma.

criteria.label: Age at least 18 years on the date of registration

evidence.quote: (i) The minimum age of the beneficiary should be 18 years on the date of registration.

criteria.label: Engaged in the trade, and has not taken loans under similar Central or State self-employment credit schemes in the past 5 years (fully repaid MUDRA and SVANidhi loans are allowed)

evidence.quote: (ii) The beneficiary should be engaged in the trades concerned on the date of registration and should not have availed loans under similar credit-based schemes of Central Government or State Government for self-employment

criteria.label: Only one member of the family (husband, wife and unmarried children) can register

evidence.quote: (iii) The registration and benefits under the Scheme shall be restricted to one member of the family.

criteria.label: Neither you nor your family members are in government service

evidence.quote: (iv) A person in government service and his/her family members shall not be eligible under the Scheme.

benefits.text: Training stipend of Rs. 500 per day during Basic and Advanced Training.

evidence.quote: Each beneficiary will be eligible to receive a training stipend of Rs. 500 per day while undergoing the Basic and Advanced Training programmes.

benefits.text: Collateral-free credit support, with a first tranche of up to Rs 1 lakh after skill assessment and basic training, at concessional interest.

evidence.quote: The beneficiary must have undergone Skill Assessment and completed Basic Training to be eligible to avail first tranche of credit support of upto Rs 1 lakh under the Scheme.

documents.name: Aadhaar, mobile number, bank details and ration card (Aadhaar of all family members if there is no ration card)

evidence.quote: The beneficiary needs to produce documents like Aadhaar, mobile number, bank details, ration card for the registration.

applicationProcess: Register through a Common Service Centre (CSC). Details are verified by the Gram Panchayat / Urban Local Body.

sources.title: PM Vishwakarma Scheme Guidelines (v30.0)
sources.evidenceNotes: Section 4 'Eligibility', 3.2.3 training stipend, credit support, 5.1 enrolment documents.
